title: The Planet That Would Float
hook: Saturn is a giant planet, and it is lighter than water.
script: Saturn is a giant planet, and it is lighter than water. It weighs ninety-five times more than Earth, yet it would float. Its average density is only 0.687 grams per cubic centimetre. So why is a planet that big so light? Because it is mostly hydrogen and helium, the lightest gases there are. Under the clouds there is no solid ground at all. Just gas, getting thicker and hotter the deeper you go. Is there anything to float in? You would need a bathtub bigger than the planet. Even its rings are mostly water ice, which is denser than the planet they circle.
